title: Everything else falls to `else`
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

given.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
true match {
  case n is Number -> "num"
  case null -> "isNull"
  else -> "other"
}

solution:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
true match {
  case n is Number -> "num"
  case null -> "isNull"
  else -> "other"
}

explanation.approach: A Boolean matches none of the specific cases, so it lands on `else` — this is where a corrupted `retries` field (a string, a boolean, an object) ends up as `INVALID`.
